summary: Tuesday's close saw a broad equity bounce, with small caps outrunning the S&P while defensive staples kept beating tech over the past two weeks. Long Treasuries extended a sharp rally into bond-market greed, and gold slipped as the dollar firmed and its momentum faded below the 50-day average. Credit spreads stayed stressed even as overall sentiment held neutral.
tweet: Stocks bounced broadly Tuesday but tech kept lagging staples, Treasuries extended their rally into greed territory, and gold slipped as the dollar firmed.
